screenshots.title: 9 apps with optional labels
screenshots.description: Compare four ordinary shortcuts with nine widget apps in equal 2 × 2 launcher footprints. App names are enabled on this transparent Grid.
screenshots.altText: Nine colorful app icons with labels in a compact grid beside four regular home-screen shortcuts.

screenshots.title: 12 apps on a light background
screenshots.description: Twelve apps in a 3 × 4 grid, still using only a 2 × 2 launcher footprint. The Light preset adds an adjustable pale background with rounded corners.
screenshots.altText: Twelve colorful app icons in a compact grid on a light rounded background.

screenshots.title: 16 apps where four shortcuts fit
screenshots.description: Sixteen distinct apps on a tall 1440 × 3120 phone, compared with four ordinary shortcuts in the same 2 × 2 launcher footprint. Rows and columns are independent of the launcher's grid.
screenshots.altText: Sixteen icons in a compact grid on a tall phone, beside four regular shortcuts occupying the same launcher space.

screenshots.title: Just your apps, within your thumb’s reach
screenshots.description: Thirteen apps in the default right-thumb arrangement on a large 1440 × 3120 phone, low on a plain black screen with no dock. A real Android widget host shows the transparent widget with independently set inner and outer reach; all artwork is original packaged app artwork.
screenshots.altText: Thirteen colorful icons arranged for the right thumb at the bottom-right of a large phone, on plain black with no dock.

screenshots.title: A grayscale thumb selector in the lower left
screenshots.description: A customized 12-app selector in the lower left of a tall 1440 × 3120 phone. Original icons use the Grayscale option over a Forest background with a subtle border.
screenshots.altText: Twelve grayscale app icons in a left-thumb layout near the bottom-left of a tall phone.

screenshots.title: Eight apps in a dark strip
screenshots.description: Eight apps across one launcher row, compared with five ordinary shortcuts per row above it. A dark background, border, rounded corners, and 80% icon opacity style the strip.
screenshots.altText: Eight colorful app icons in one horizontal strip, with a dark background.

screenshots.title: Choose original colors, grayscale, or tint
screenshots.description: The actual Visual options screen shows all three icon-color choices while its live preview displays the selected gradient background.
screenshots.altText: Visual options showing original colors, grayscale and tint choices, with a live preview.

screenshots.title: Independent icon sizes for each layer
screenshots.description: Adjust layer sizes independently: 80%, 100%, and 115%. The live preview retains all 12 apps, their order, and the actual compact widget dimensions.
screenshots.altText: Three independent layer-size sliders at 80%, 100% and 115%, under a live colored thumb-widget preview.
